title: Networks of stress, affect and eating behaviour: anticipated stress coping predicts goal-congruent eating in young adults
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Sample limited to young, predominantly female, academic participants; - No differentiation of specific coping styles; - No differentiation of food environments; - Moderate sample size may limit sensitivity to detect all edges.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Data and code are available upon reasonable request from the corresponding author.
